description:
We are seeking a Full Stack Application Developer to join our team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to a major architectural overhaul of our internal business intelligence environment. You will take complete ownership of  frontend interfaces and backend services that directly influence the productivity and data visibility of our global support organization, helping us move towards a modern, high-performance tech stack.
 Who You’ll Work With 
 You will join the Business Intelligence (BI) and Tools team—a collaborative group of engineers and analysts dedicated to building the engine that powers Arista’s world-class support. We act as an internal innovation hub, creating the real-time tools and data visualizations that allow our support organization to scale at a pace that matches Arista’s rapid growth. You will have a seat at the table in architectural discussions and the opportunity to own features from concept to production.
 What You’ll Do 
 Core Frontend Architecture: Design, build, and maintain robust, highly responsive web applications utilizing Next.js and React. Take ownership of the front-end architecture, leveraging Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) to ensure lightning-fast performance and seamless user experiences.

 UI/UX Delivery: Develop intuitive, user-facing features with a strong focus on accessibility, responsive design. Build Re-usable front-end libraries using strong TypeScript fundamentals and modern styling practices.

 Cloud Deployment & DevOps: Manage the deployment and infrastructure of our frontend applications. Utilize Docker and GitLab CI/CD to automate builds and deploy Next.js applications directly to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Virtual Machines, ensuring high availability and seamless delivery.

 API Integration & State Management: Write clean, optimized client-side logic to efficiently handle data flow, state management, and asynchronous backend API calls to connect with frontend.

 Core Backend Engineering (Good to have): Design and maintain robust APIs utilizing Python-based backend web-development frameworks, ensuring high performance, logical problem-solving, and reliable data delivery.

 Frontend Security & Performance(Good to have): Collaborate with the security team to assist with client-side security audits (e.g., mitigating XSS, CSRF). Continuously monitor and optimize Core Web Vitals to ensure strict adherence to performance and security policies.

 Test-Driven Development & Quality Assurance(Good to have): Implement Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices for UI components using modern frontend testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress). Participate in rigorous code reviews to catch defects early and ensure high software quality.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proactively communicate with Leads, backend engineers, and product stakeholders to bridge the gap between design and technical execution, ensuring a mutual understanding of user needs and project scope.

 
 Experience: 1- 4 years of professional experience in full-stack web application development

 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 UI/UX Development: Deep understanding of JavaScript core principles and practical experience implementing interfaces with React, favoring familiarity with Next.js architectures.

 Product Mindset: The ability to translate user needs into clean, functional, and efficient code with high standards for documentation.

 DevOps & Infrastructure: Practical experience with deployment, containerization, and cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred).

 Backend Expertise (Good to have): Strong proficiency in Python-based backend web development, core software development problem-solving, and generalized API development.

 Data Expertise(Good to have): Strong proficiency in relational database technologies, including schema design, performance tuning, and optimizing complex queries for large-scale data pipelines.

 AI/LLM Experience(Good to have): Experience with agentic AI development and/or Large Language Models (LLMs) is preferred.

 Please Note:  Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. The Company will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time. 

 
 Arista Networks is an equal opportunity employer.  Arista makes all hiring and employment-related decisions in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or any other factor determined to be unlawful under applicable federal, state, or law law.  All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
